summary: Frontend testing for Auto Re-Push, Night Audit Robot (Gece Denetim Robotu / morning-report), and Proposal Win Analysis. Most flows PASSED after applying null-safety fix in MorningReportPanel (see updated_files). One backend data-contract bug discovered: GET /api/morning-report/{pid} returns MIXED records — the new morning_audits (correct schema with room_revenue/adr/occupancy_pct at top-level) PLUS legacy ops night-audit checklist docs (audit_date/checks/occupancy.occupancy_pct nested) — this caused the panel to crash (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLocaleString')` at MorningReportPanel line 95 map). Verified: HotelRunner drift = 'Uyumlu' (green), hr-repush-btn hidden, hr-auto-repush-toggle checked=true, off-toast 'Otomatik yeniden push kapatıldı' and on-toast 'Otomatik yeniden push AÇIK — sapmalar 6 saatte bir kendiliğinden düzeltilir'. Morning report: last section shows occ 116.7% / rev ₺731.77 / adr ₺104.54 / moves 5/2 / anomalies green, history table renders 3 rows (but 2 legacy rows show %0/₺0 due to mixed data). fs-win-section renders: badge 'Kazanma oranı: %75' → after reject flipped to %60, value ₺2.475, chart with Bekleyen/Kabul/Red bars for 2026-08, loss reasons fiyat:1 → after reject fiyat:1 + rakip:1. Reject-with-reason: 6 options [fiyat,tarih,mekan,rakip,iptal,diğer], toast 'Teklif reddedildi — neden kaydedildi', status flipped to Red. Regressions: hr-push-btn MOCK toast fires ('MOCK push simüle edildi (14 gün)'), los-wash-metrics-btn present. Auto-repush toggle LEFT ON at end.

critical.issue: Returns mixed audit records — new morning_audits (Gece Denetim Robotu schema with top-level room_revenue/adr/occupancy_pct) AND legacy ops night-audit checklist docs (audit_date/checks/occupancy.occupancy_pct nested, no top-level room_revenue). This crashed MorningReportPanel because .toLocaleString was called on undefined room_revenue. Problem statement explicitly states this endpoint must be 'distinct from existing ops night-audit checklist'. Fix: filter query to only return docs with schema key `date` (or add `source: 'morning_robot'` marker) and exclude legacy `audit_date` docs. History table currently shows ghost rows with %0 ₺0 for legacy records.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' during history table render — <tr key={a.date}> conflicts when legacy audits share the same date or missing date. Not blocking but should be fixed after backend cleanup.

rca of the issue: MorningReportPanel crash RCA: backend endpoint /api/morning-report/{pid} queries a MongoDB collection that contains BOTH the new Gece Denetim Robotu audits (schema: {date, room_revenue, adr, occupancy_pct, anomalies[], ...}) AND legacy ops night-audit checklist audits (schema: {audit_date, overall_status, checks{}, occupancy{occupancy_pct,adr}, revenue{room_revenue}}). Frontend iterates `audits.map(a => a.room_revenue.toLocaleString(...))` — legacy docs have no top-level `room_revenue`, causing TypeError and ErrorBoundary fallback ('Bir şeyler ters gitti'). Mitigation applied at frontend: null-safety `(a.room_revenue ?? 0).toLocaleString(...)`. Real fix belongs in backend night_audit.py: query only new schema (e.g., filter `date` exists, or use dedicated collection like morning_audits, or add a discriminator field like source='morning_robot').
